typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		LAST_ER_VISIT as string,
		CLIENT as string,
		RUN_DATE as string,
		SUBSCRIBER_ID as string,
		SUB_ID_TYPE as string,
		CMS_MEDICARE_ID as string,
		CMS_MEDICAID_ID as string,
		MBR_FIRST as string,
		MBR_LAST as string,
		DOB as string,
		GENDER as string,
		EFF_DATE as string,
		EXP_DATE as string,
		ADDRESS as string,
		CITY as string,
		STATE as string,
		ZIP as string,
		PHONE1 as string,
		PHONE1_TYPE as string,
		PHONE2 as string,
		PHONE2_TYPE as string,
		SMS_CONSENT as string,
		EMAIL as string,
		EMAIL_CONSENT as string,
		PLAN_CODE as string,
		LANGUAGE as string,
		RX_HISTORY as string,
		RENAL_FAILURE as string,
		CONDITION as string,
		ER_DIAGNOSIS as string,
		LAST_IP_VISIT as string,
		IP_DIAGNOSIS as string,
		SERVICE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT    CLIENT                ,RUN_DATE 	,SUBSCRIBER_ID 	,SUB_ID_TYPE                 ,CMS_MEDICARE_ID 	,CMS_MEDICAID_ID 	,MBR_FIRST 	,MBR_LAST 	,DOB 	,GENDER 	,EFF_DATE 	,EXP_DATE   	,ADDRESS   	,CITY   	,STATE   	,ZIP   	,PHONE1   	,PHONE1_TYPE   	,PHONE2   	,PHONE2_TYPE   	,SMS_CONSENT   	,EMAIL   	,EMAIL_CONSENT   	,PLAN_CODE 	,LANGUAGE   	,RX_HISTORY   	,RENAL_FAILURE   	,CONDITION   	,LAST_ER_VISIT  	,ER_DIAGNOSIS  	,LAST_IP_VISIT  	,IP_DIAGNOSIS  	,SERVICE   	from [Extract].[GA_VRI_PHYSICAL_MATERNAL_MEMBER]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> GAVRIMaternal
GAVRIMaternal derive(SERVICE = toString(SERVICE),
		SMS_CONSENT = toString(SMS_CONSENT),
		RUN_DATE = toString(RUN_DATE),
		PHONE1_TYPE = toString(PHONE1_TYPE),
		CMS_MEDICARE_ID = toString(CMS_MEDICARE_ID),
		STATE = toString(STATE),
		CMS_MEDICAID_ID = toString(CMS_MEDICAID_ID),
		RENAL_FAILURE = toString(RENAL_FAILURE),
		RX_HISTORY = toString(RX_HISTORY),
		PHONE2_TYPE = toString(PHONE2_TYPE),
		LAST_ER_VISIT = toString(LAST_ER_VISIT),
		CONDITION = toString(CONDITION),
		LAST_IP_VISIT = toString(LAST_IP_VISIT),
		GENDER = toString(GENDER),
		SUBSCRIBER_ID = toString(SUBSCRIBER_ID),
		IP_DIAGNOSIS = toString(IP_DIAGNOSIS),
		ZIP = toString(ZIP),
		DOB = toString(DOB),
		CLIENT = toString(CLIENT),
		MBR_FIRST = toString(MBR_FIRST),
		PHONE2 = toString(PHONE2),
		SUB_ID_TYPE = toString(SUB_ID_TYPE),
		CITY = toString(CITY),
		EMAIL = toString(EMAIL),
		MBR_LAST = toString(MBR_LAST),
		LANGUAGE = toString(LANGUAGE),
		ADDRESS = toString(ADDRESS),
		EMAIL_CONSENT = toString(EMAIL_CONSENT),
		EFF_DATE = toString(EFF_DATE),
		ER_DIAGNOSIS = toString(ER_DIAGNOSIS),
		PLAN_CODE = toString(PLAN_CODE),
		EXP_DATE = toString(EXP_DATE),
		PHONE1 = toString(PHONE1)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion split(SERVICE == 'REMOTE Monitoring Physical Health Program',SERVICE == 'REMOTE Monitoring Maternal Health Program', disjoint: true) ~> ConditionalSplit@(PhysialHealth,MaternalHealth,ConditionalSplitDefaultOutput)
ConditionalSplit@PhysialHealth derive({} = {}) ~> PlaceHolderPhysicalHealthRecordcount
ConditionalSplit@MaternalHealth derive() ~> PlaceHolderMaternalrecordcount
PlaceHolderPhysicalHealthRecordcount sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> PhysicalHealth
PlaceHolderMaternalrecordcount sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> MaternalHealth
